propositions: Reconciler read/check paths currently call load_config() and inspect environment/cwd at runtime, allowing ambient settings to change read scope or discard supplied registry config during a single operation

S2 requires constructing exactly one immutable Jira backend from focused ReconcilerSettings/GitRuntime/BridgeRuntime projections with stable project/query scope, TLS, timeout/limits, and auth, rather than allowing lazy backend reload

All read paths (preflight, access check, fetch, paging, diff, mapper, sanitizer, tracker reads, Git ref reads) must thread the same backend/runtime and remove ambient reloads to guarantee supplied config remains authoritative
Static auth fields must use non-serializable Pydantic SecretStr/SecretBytes, excluded from repr/equality/hash/cache/fingerprint, and unwrap only in the selected Jira sending adapter
Failure cases (missing/conflicting auth, empty scope, malformed config) must fail before any Jira model request or local write with typed/redacted errors and no anonymous/cross-provider fallback
